recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the work group wants new Measure-specific guidance beyond the generic Period extension, which should be handled as a new decision.
issue_request: FHIR-24623 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Measure. It requested support for expressing Measure.effectivePeriod using an anchor date/time and duration/range; the later Jira comment proposed the simpler application path of a general Period extension carrying a Duration.
initial_application: The issue was applied by J#24623 commits 6cdb0d85a3 and 0b6b322dd1, merged by PR #2263 as 0326a4cfa4. Those commits added periodDuration as an artifact extension for Period and added Clinical Reasoning module narrative describing start-date-plus-duration use.
additional_context: FHIR-21988 is the FHIR-us-qm background issue that requested measurement-period support without specifying a year and called for the R5 core tracker. Core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source in dd468d4f17 and converted links to Extension Pack placeholders in b3e373388f. The Extension Pack currently defines artifact-periodDuration with context Period and value Duration, while active core Measure still defines Measure.effectivePeriod as Period and links to the external extension.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core and Extension Pack sources already provide the requested representation, and reintroducing a core-local extension definition or Measure-only wording would duplicate the generic Period extension and conflict with current extension-pack ownership.
